description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Oregon Revised Statutes — Oregon state law — by citation. "ORS 163.115" is second degree murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does ORS 163.115 say" or to check an Oregon statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "163.115" (murder 2) or "813.010" (DUII). Chapter is the part before the dot.

name: or_revised_statute
title: Or Revised Statute
